[{"insert":"Seated Strict Press

The seated strict press removes any leg drive and forces the shoulders to do all the work overhead. Sitting also limits lower back compensation, which makes the demand on the deltoid more honest than a standing press. Four working sets with a max unbroken drop set at the end. Keep the bar path vertical and brace the core on every rep.
"}]
